scope: Lossless structured caller content reconstruction using the unchanged canonical native fixture; original JSON whitespace and gzip envelope are historical, not reconstructed. Synthetic host control, not serialized-note or device evidence.

host_boundaries: ObjectDrawing context vslot +16 supplies the screen-profile object; its vtable +32/+40 returns explicit width/height
context vslot +80 is a host identity ARGB callback (entry input and returned W0 captured)
context vslots +144/+152 return explicit flags/version values 1 and 1.0
canvas/bitmap/context/resource/ownership adapters and managed task queue registration are host; queued task Run methods, Drawing selection, Marker3 wrapper, and saved geometry execute natively
common_case_fields.scope: Native Drawing caller plus direct RedrawPen through the selected GLV5 vtable slot under an explicit synthetic profile. This does not exercise SDK deserialization, Samsung device defaults, renderer pixels, or SVG/PDF export.

encoding.callbacks: Each changes entry updates the preceding callback object; xy is reconstructed as the first vector_count pairs of the canonical phase vector. All remaining fields, including addresses and xy_bits, are retained exactly.
encoding.lifecycle: Each changes entry updates the preceding lifecycle entry; regs_changes updates its register map and removed_fields deletes fields absent from the next entry. No lifecycle entry is dropped or reordered.
